controls: Read-only status output exposes a versioned manifest explicitly labeled as declarations rather than runtime measurements.
Transcript provenance distinguishes real_model_inference, synthetic_transcript_replay, measured_digital_silence_no_inference and unverified non-inference output.
Synthetic replay may include predeclared transcript text and always reports inference_executed=false.
Measured digital silence reports no model inference and no generated transcript text; contradictory silence/inference output fails closed.
Multichannel transcripts aggregate per-channel inference modes without relabeling silent-only or mixed execution as replay.
Manifest discloses deterministic drafting defaults, synthetic-only optional model use, clinician-confirmed diarization and that model verification cannot clear approval.

limitations: The manifest does not dynamically prove a local model is installed or that a given request executed inference; per-transcript provenance records the adapter-reported path.
Real model inference here means trusted adapter execution, not clinical accuracy or deployment eligibility.
